Min Order 1 During the past few years it's generally been accepted that analogue float type flow meters cannot always provide an accurate indication of performance when used in low flow rate applications. With its unique integrated flow adjustment valve, which can be added or disconnected by simply removing its retaining clip, linear flow rate can be adjusted manually by rotating the flow rate adjustment knob. Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: IZD10-110
DESCRIPTION: IZD10, Electrostatic Sensor
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Potential Measurement: 1 (±0.4kV)
LONG DESCRIPTION: A build up of static electricity during the manufacturing process often results in poor final production quality and substantially lower output. To help detect and monitor this naturally occurring phenomenon engineers from SMC, the world's leading automation experts, have now provided the solution with the launch of their new IZD10 and IZE11 Electrostatic Sensor and Electrostatic Sensor Monitor.Originally developed to work alongside SMC's IZS31 Ioniser, the new electrostatic sensor and sensor monitor can accurately measure the potential levels of static before the introduction of any countermeasures and importantly confirm the effective performance of any countermeasures which have been introduced. The IZD10 sensor is currently available in two options depending on the magnitude of the charged object - ±0.4 kV at 25 mm, ±20 kV at 50 mm - with a detection distance between 10 to 50 mm and 25 to 75 mm respectively.Readings from the sensor are converted into a 1 – 5 V output which can be viewed on the extremely compact 30 mm square, IZE11 digital sensor monitor or other instrumentation for downstream analysis.With its red and green colour digital display, the sensor monitor can be adjusted to one of four different display patterns and it can be ordered with either NPN or PNP switch outputs and either 1 – 5 V or 4 – 20 mA analogue output specifications.
BULLET POINTS: Potential measurement: ±20 kV (detected at a 50 mm distance), ±0.4 kV (detected at a 25 mm distance). Analogue output: the measured electrostatic potential is converted into a 1 to 5 V output that can be used with the electrostatic monitor IZE11. Small and easy to mount.

Title: SMC IZE113-LC ELECTROSTATIC SENSOR MONITOR incl VAT
Description: SMC IZE113-LC ELECTROSTATIC SENSOR MONITOR incl VAT Contact us for lead time.  Min Order 1 A build up of static electricity during the manufacturing process often results in poor final production quality and substantially lower output.  To help detect and monitor this naturally occurring phenomenon engineers from SMC, the world's leading automation experts, have now provided the solution with the launch of their new IZD10 and IZE11 Electrostatic Sensor and Electrostatic Sensor Monitor.Originally developed to work alongside SMC's IZS31 Ioniser, the new electrostatic sensor and sensor monitor can accurately measure the potential levels of static before the introduction of any countermeasures and importantly confirm the effective performance of any countermeasures which have been introduced. The IZD10 sensor is currently available in two options depending on the magnitude of the charged object - ±0.4 kV at 25 mm, ±20 kV at 50 mm -  with a detection distance between 10 to 50 mm and 25 to 75 mm respectively.Readings from the sensor are converted into a 1 – 5 V output which can be viewed on the extremely compact 30 mm square, IZE11 digital sensor monitor or other instrumentation for downstream analysis.With its red and green colour digital display, the sensor monitor can be adjusted to one of four different display patterns and it can be ordered with either NPN or PNP switch outputs and either 1 – 5 V or 4 – 20 mA analogue output specifications.

Title: SMC IZD10-510 STATIC SENSOR Incl VAT
Description:
Brand: SMC
PART NUMBER: IZD10-510
DESCRIPTION: IZD10, Electrostatic Sensor
PROPERTIES/VALUES: Potential Measurement: 5 (±20kV)
LONG DESCRIPTION: A build up of static electricity during the manufacturing process often results in poor final production quality and substantially lower output. To help detect and monitor this naturally occurring phenomenon engineers from SMC, the world's leading automation experts, have now provided the solution with the launch of their new IZD10 and IZE11 Electrostatic Sensor and Electrostatic Sensor Monitor.Originally developed to work alongside SMC's IZS31 Ioniser, the new electrostatic sensor and sensor monitor can accurately measure the potential levels of static before the introduction of any countermeasures and importantly confirm the effective performance of any countermeasures which have been introduced. The IZD10 sensor is currently available in two options depending on the magnitude of the charged object - ±0.4 kV at 25 mm, ±20 kV at 50 mm - with a detection distance between 10 to 50 mm and 25 to 75 mm respectively.Readings from the sensor are converted into a 1 – 5 V output which can be viewed on the extremely compact 30 mm square, IZE11 digital sensor monitor or other instrumentation for downstream analysis.With its red and green colour digital display, the sensor monitor can be adjusted to one of four different display patterns and it can be ordered with either NPN or PNP switch outputs and either 1 – 5 V or 4 – 20 mA analogue output specifications.
BULLET POINTS: Potential measurement: ±20 kV (detected at a 50 mm distance), ±0.4 kV (detected at a 25 mm distance). Analogue output: the measured electrostatic potential is converted into a 1 to 5 V output that can be used with the electrostatic monitor IZE11. Small and easy to mount.

Title: SMC D-M9BWVL Auto Switch incl VAT
Description: SMC D-M9BWVL Auto Switch incl VAT Contact us for lead time.  Min Order 1 A build up of static electricity during the manufacturing process often results in poor final production quality and substantially lower output.  To help detect and monitor this naturally occurring phenomenon engineers from SMC, the world's leading automation experts, have now provided the solution with the launch of their new IZD10 and IZE11 Electrostatic Sensor and Electrostatic Sensor Monitor.Originally developed to work alongside SMC's IZS31 Ioniser, the new electrostatic sensor and sensor monitor can accurately measure the potential levels of static before the introduction of any countermeasures and importantly confirm the effective performance of any countermeasures which have been introduced. The IZD10 sensor is currently available in two options depending on the magnitude of the charged object - ±0.4 kV at 25 mm, ±20 kV at 50 mm -  with a detection distance between 10 to 50 mm and 25 to 75 mm respectively.Readings from the sensor are converted into a 1 – 5 V output which can be viewed on the extremely compact 30 mm square, IZE11 digital sensor monitor or other instrumentation for downstream analysis.With its red and green colour digital display, the sensor monitor can be adjusted to one of four different display patterns and it can be ordered with either NPN or PNP switch outputs and either 1 – 5 V or 4 – 20 mA analogue output specifications.

Description:
Brand: SMC

DESCRIPTION: IZH10, Handheld Electrostatic Meter

LONG DESCRIPTION: When the natural build up of static electricity causes production line or machine function problems, its early detection and eradication can often be the difference between success and failure. Title: SMC ZPR25UN-06-A6 VACUUM PAD incl VAT
Description: SMC ZPR25UN-06-A6 VACUUM PAD incl VAT Contact us for lead time.  Min Order 1 During the past few years it's generally been accepted that analogue float type flow meters cannot always provide an accurate indication of performance when used in low flow rate applications.  But now, thanks to R&D engineers from SMC, the world's leading automation experts and their new Series PFM Digital Flow Switch using MEMS technology, this simply isn't the case.Developed initially to detect microchip component adsorption in vacuum and early clogging in both filter and nozzle applications, the new Series PFM Flow Switch is incredibly compact and lightweight compared to existing flow sensors thanks to its micro electro mechanical system (MEMS) sensor. Description: SMC PFMV304-M VOLTAGE MONITOR incl VAT Contact us for lead time. Min Order 1 One of the challenges faced by machine builders is the repeated request for smaller and more compact machines. Min Order 1 One of the challenges faced by machine builders is the repeated request for smaller and more compact machines. Thanks to the development of a unique patented elliptical retaining ring, which eliminates the need for cylinder end caps, Series CQU is up to 15% shorter than the MU, 40% narrower than the CQ2 and offers a body mass reduction of up to 36% depending on the selected model. Designed for use with a small auto switch – which can be fitted in 4 directions – Series CQU can also be mounted using vertical, horizontal, foot and double clevis options.

Description: SMC CQUB20-20M COMPACT CYLINDER incl VAT Contact us for lead time.  Min Order 1 One of the challenges faced by machine builders is the repeated request for smaller and more compact machines. In many cases this challenge is not too difficult to achieve but often major size reductions are restricted by the performance of the components used in its construction.As the world leaders in pneumatics, SMC are very much aware of these issues and their new Series CQU compact plate type cylinder meets this challenge with both power and space saving performance.Designed for use in general automation application, the CQU range offers the best performance features of SMC´s popular Series MU plate cylinder and Series CQ2 compact cylinders in one exceptionally small plate cylinder body. Thanks to the development of a unique patented elliptical retaining ring, which eliminates the need for cylinder end caps, Series CQU is up to 15% shorter than the MU, 40% narrower than the CQ2 and offers a body mass reduction of up to 36% depending on the selected model. A further benefit of this innovative construction ensures that the CQU range is also dramatically lighter than any plate cylinder currently in the market.Ideal for tight pitch mounting applications or where you need to mount a cylinder with a low centre of gravity, Series CQU can also be used with an external guide. Designed for use with a small auto switch – which can be fitted in 4 directions – Series CQU can also be mounted using vertical, horizontal, foot and double clevis options.
